item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line & Red Line Low Profile Flag Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Thin Blue Line & Thin Red Line Low Profile Flag Cap is designed to honor the bravery and sacrifice of law enforcement officers and firefighters. Featuring an embroidered US flag with both the Thin Blue Line and Thin Red Line, this cap is a powerful symbol of respect and support for first responders. Made from durable brushed cotton twill, the cap offers a comfortable fit for everyday wear. The adjustable hook & loop closure ensures a customized fit, while the low-profile design provides a sleek, modern look.
description: Rothco’s Thin Blue Line & Thin Red Line Low Profile Flag Cap is designed to honor the bravery and sacrifice of law enforcement officers and firefighters. Featuring an embroidered US flag with both the Thin Blue Line and Thin Red Line, this cap is a powerful symbol of respect and support for first responders. Made from durable brushed cotton twill, the cap offers a comfortable fit for everyday wear. The adjustable hook & loop closure ensures a customized fit, while the low-profile design provides a sleek, modern look. Perfect for anyone who wants to show their appreciation for the selfless service of police officers and firefighters, this cap not only represents solidarity but also contributes to a worthy cause—proceeds from each purchase go toward families of fallen first responders. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
